desc: Ideation: derive neighbor structure (prefix+suffix in L-sorted order), prove diameter ≤ 3 for intersecting connected pairs, reduce answer to 1D range-min queries (PM_R over R-sorted, SM_L over L-sorted)

Implement final solution: parsing, sorted-by-R prefix-min of W, sorted-by-L suffix-min of W, per-query formula with strict-inequality bisects (bisect_left for R<X, bisect_right for L>X), INF handling, fast IO
Stress-test against brute-force Dijkstra on random small inputs (nested intervals, ties in L/R, isolated vertices, N=2 edge cases) and verify both samples; no discrepancies found
